column1: AX-HUD shows the video from the HDMI input of your AX12 full screen, with a HUD on top, and speaks announcements and warnings. It only reads from the radio and never writes to it. This guide takes about a minute.
column2: AX-HUD 会把 AX12 的 HDMI 输入视频全屏显示, 在上面叠加 HUD, 并语音播报提示和警告。它只从遥控器读取数据, 绝不向其写入。本指南大约需要一分钟。

column1: The HDMI input reaches Android as a camera, so AX-HUD needs the camera permission. If you said no by mistake, allow it in the Android settings, under Apps, AX-HUD, Permissions. Without it you see the gray No video screen.
column2: HDMI 输入在 Android 中被识别为相机, 所以 AX-HUD 需要相机权限。如果你误点了拒绝, 请在 Android 设置的“应用”、AX-HUD、“权限”中允许。没有权限时, 你只会看到灰色的“无视频”画面。

column1: The first data takes about 12 seconds

After you open the app, the radio data (sticks, link quality, telemetry) appears after about 12 seconds. That wait is inside the RadioMaster SDK and is not an error. A banner counts the seconds. The video starts at once.
column2: 打开应用后, 遥控器数据(摇杆、链路质量、遥测)大约 12 秒后才会出现。这段等待发生在 RadioMaster SDK 内部, 不是错误。横幅会显示已等待的秒数。视频会立即开始。

column1: Tap MENU at the top right for nine tiles: Sound rules, Speech, Battery, Aircraft, Sunlight, Dashboard, Flight logs, Settings and Exit. Choose your aircraft and battery pack first, because their limits drive the warnings. Sunlight: dark text on light, for direct sun. Settings holds the overlays, the layout, the checks, the flight logs, the languages and the updates.
column2: 点按右上角的“菜单”会看到九个图块: 语音规则、语音、电池、飞行器、阳光、仪表盘、飞行日志、设置和退出。请先选择你的飞行器和电池组, 因为警告取决于它们的限值。“阳光”: 浅色背景深色文字。“设置”中包含叠加显示、布局、检查、飞行日志、语言和更新。
